title: Yellowed Roasted Egyptian Swede Roast
description: A keto-friendly Egyptian dish featuring roasted swede with a yuzu cure, resulting in a bouncy and indulgent treat. This recipe combines the sweetness of swede with the tanginess of yuzu.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the swede cubes with olive oil, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and paprika until they are evenly coated.
Spread the swede cubes in a single layer on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the swede in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until it is tender and lightly browned.
While the swede is roasting, mix the yuzu juice with 2 tablespoons of water in a small bowl.
After the swede has roasted for 30 minutes, brush the yuzu juice mixture evenly over the swede cubes.
Return the swede to the oven and continue roasting for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until it is caramelized and yellowed.
Remove the swede from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
